experiment: QNATIVE-2 shared cross-conditioned natural-variable-question development transfer
basis: NATIVE-2 independently reconstructed complete cross-only development win. Both failed factorized arms retained. Architecture and gates chosen before any QASPER model forward; no QASPER model outcome selected them.
supersession: Original question study and its old authority remain immutable. Resolve its original NATIVE-2 protocol through the byte-identical preserved timeout snapshot. This explicit amendment authorizes measured v2 lineage and fixes architecture/gates; source projections, membership and native targets unchanged.

question_study.reader: Only neutral_qasper_native_compile.open_phase for train/dev; calibration/confirmation/final/unused stay sealed and unopened.
question_study.split: Reuse the frozen NATIVE-1 inner component split (fit/selection/calibration) computed from component_id; QASPER train only. DEV is development assessment, never a sealed final.

qasper.yes_no.target: Native per-annotation yes_no; gold is the filtered retained-annotation distribution, never population truth.

qasper.answerability.target: Exact complement of native unanswerable; null/absent never becomes a class.

qasper.evidence_retrieval.target: Exact-block evidence; all unmatched native evidence retained in the denominator.

qasper.extractive_answer.target: Exact substring spans; unmatched spans retained in the denominator.

question_study.serving: Exact source-only rendered state, original question (with the registered prefix for answerability/evidence), and source-only candidate catalogue. No gold, IDs, splits or annotations in model text.

data.native_intent_replay: All original NATIVE-1 FIT only, identical original train/selection/calibration/DEV membership. Replay Banking77/MASSIVE fit decisions through unchanged NATIVE-2 cross path; DEV never optimized.
data.joint_sources: One shared encoder and retained native cross scorer, not an endpoint-dispatched second model. Original endpoints must be measured after question training.
data.model_visible: Verbatim rendered question and exact source-only block text. IDs, phase, components, native annotations, target distributions, resolved gold spans and free-form answers are never model text. Blocks come from the registered source-only retrieval candidate catalogue, joined to other endpoints by custody IDs outside model text.
data.reader: Only existing guarded open_phase(train/dev) for projection streams and guarded native_field_data reader for the original English intent phases; sealed phases remain closed.
data.denominators: Every registered row retained. Native unmatched evidence and extraction strings remain native item denominators. Null/absent/empty arrays are separately reported, never fabricated into a gold class, negative token labels or successful abstention. Report support loss from token boundaries and window-length limitations separately. Never drop errors, unsupported rows or zero-control denominators.

model.architecture: Shared NATIVE-2 cross encoder. Natural-question paths jointly encode question and each source block window; retain the existing cross scoring head for evidence relevance. Add one binary linear readout over pooled joint token states and one three-tag BIO linear readout over source token states. Native intent uses unchanged state+candidate cross path.
model.initialization: Strict NATIVE-2 cross selected checkpoint (epoch10), complete encoder/head; seed7 for new readouts. No stock-only replacement or silent missing key. One resident model; no capacity/depth sweep, separate question encoder, state-only representation or learned candidate parser.
model.question_budget: Preserve every question token. Per-block window capacity512 minus exact question and tokenizer pair-special token count. Input-only preflight refuses any question leaving no source token capacity before model work; never silently truncate questions.
model.document_windows: All original blocks, all source tokens in deterministic overlapping windows. Overlap min(64,window_capacity-1), stride capacity-overlap. No gold- or score-dependent source truncation, lexical shortlist or top-k omission. Record token/char offsets, overlaps, original position, all window counts and full source coverage.
model.pool: Use canonical masked_mean. Evidence score per block is maximum retained cross head score over its windows. Bool logits per question are relevance-softmax-weighted window binary logits, then categorical softmax. Span BIO uses source token positions only; question/special/padding tokens excluded.
model.span_decode: Independent greedy BIO tags per source window: I without preceding B/I starts a source span; source offsets produce verbatim strings. Deduplicate equal (block,start,end) and merge intersecting intervals within a block, never across blocks; adjacency alone is not merged. Return all decoded spans, source order, with exact offsets. Never generate or repair answer text.
model.ranking: Full source catalogue, descending block score, stable semantic block ID tie break. Output IDs are coordinates only and are never encoder text. Reorder keeps source IDs/blocks fixed.
model.repeated_state: Joint encoding rereads source windows for distinct questions. Cache only exact input/weight-identity results; account for all state-containing sequences. Never claim question-independent state reuse, learned shortlist, latency or full-context attention from this chunked path.

training.optimizer: AdamW, encoder lr0.00002; all scoring/output heads lr0.001; weight_decay0.01; no schedule or sweep
training.order: Seeded shuffle of all FIT endpoint decisions per epoch. Accumulate one decision loss per eligible native target, mean over32 decisions including final shorter batch. Equal per-decision weights; record actual per-endpoint supervised counts and loss denominators.
training.bool_loss: Categorical CE against retained-rater false/true distribution; missing target has no invented loss.
training.retrieval_loss: Soft-target categorical CE over full block scores. Each exactly matched native item distributes its mass equally over duplicate block matches; average over matched native items. Record all unmatched items and zero-matched decisions; zero-matched native arrays supply no fabricated negative supervision.
training.BIO_loss: Map only exact source-char spans aligning with tokenizer offsets and contained in at least one source window. Preserve each observed annotation and its multi-span set. Average one-hot BIO per token over supported annotations. For partially unsupported annotations supervise known positive span tokens only, never invent negative O labels elsewhere. Wholly unsupported/absent/no-native-item annotations are unlabelled. Mean over observed supervised source tokens with fixed class weights O1,B10,I10, normalize weighted loss by summed weights.
training.checkpoint: Highest macro inner-selection primary metric across six endpoints (native2 top1, QASPER yes_no/answerability top1, native-item retrieval Recall@10, annotation token-set F1); target-unavailable rows remain coverage but not invented metric labels. Tie lower mean available Bool/intent NLL then earlier epoch. Keep epochs0..10, all candidate checkpoint selection predictions, restore strict selected fingerprint before calibration/DEV.
training.calibration: Disjoint calibration components only. One temperature per categorical endpoint on101-point log-spaced0.5..10 grid, minimize NLL, then closest to1, then smaller temperature. For extraction report raw BIO confidence and observed calibration reliability; no certificate or pseudo-probability over arbitrary strings.

baselines.Bool: FIT-only retained-rater mean probability per QASPER endpoint, constant for all inputs. Preserve majority class and raw proper scores.
baselines.retrieval: Full source-catalogue word-token TF-IDF cosine. Token regex Unicode \w+, lowercase only. IDF log((N+1)/(df+1))+1 fitted to deduplicated FIT source block texts; term frequency raw count, L2-normalized vectors. No DEV DF fit. Stable block ID ties.
baselines.extraction: Return exact full text of the top TF-IDF block as one source-offset span, no native answers or gold shortlist. Report this baseline separately, never call it a learned extractor.
baselines.original_intent: Fixed complete NATIVE-2 cross DEV and its calibration-only probabilities. Initial source checkpoint quality remains preserved separately.

Bool: top1 against argmax retained-rater distribution, false on exact tie
confidence-correctness AUROC, null if no class contrast
selective risk/coverage at fixed confidence thresholds0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8,0.9,0.95,0.99
retrieval: native-item Recall@1,@5,@10, an item hits if any exact duplicate block match is selected; unmatched items are misses
per-row, per-annotation and native-item counts; full/mixed/no support strata
full-catalogue posterior proper scores only where a native matched target exists; unmatched denominators separately retained
extraction: per-observed-nonempty-native-annotation exact set match of raw strings

per-annotation token-set F1 over union of normalized tokens from all predicted versus all native span strings; lowercase, Unicode word tokens; multiplicity via Counter, no aliases or free-form answers
per-native-item exact string recall and source position coverage; unmatched items retained
empty/unavailable target annotations reported without invented accuracy
original_intent: top1, NLL, Brier, ECE15, confidence ranking and paired delta versus original NATIVE-2 cross
metrics.statistics: Paper/input-only connected component ratio bootstrap10000 draws seed0, nominal descriptive95%, preserve all question/annotation descendants. Resampling for each endpoint reuses its frozen component universe; no annotation-as-independent-n. No simultaneous release claim.

controls.mask_question: Public empty-question string, same exact document and source catalogue, full DEV.
controls.mask_state: Public empty-evidence text in every existing block coordinate, same question and coordinates, full DEV; never pretend changed text preserves semantic source labels.
controls.question_swap: Same-paper, same-endpoint donor, next distinct question in sorted question-ID order, wrapping. Keep document/candidates fixed. Donor labels are valid only because same paper/endpoint; report teacher-changing versus stable and unsupported-control denominators. Papers with no distinct eligible donor are explicitly unpaired, never counted as correct.
controls.reorder: Reverse complete source block order without changing IDs/text; stable semantic outputs and raw score-by-ID parity within1e-6.
controls.candidate_count: Input-only nested prefixes K2,4,8,16,32,64,128,255,512,1000 intersected with actual source catalogue sizes, plus full K. Preserve membership frequency separately from learned recall; no forced gold.
controls.repeat: First DEV paper/question by ID, first two distinct available questions, three rounds, fresh cache; persist exact encoded window/sequence counters and input/weight cache keys. Distinct-question reruns pay full joint encoding, exact repeats add zero. Unavailable second question is a missing diagnostic, not a pass.
controls.required_outputs: All DEV endpoint predictions, baseline outputs, errors/support masks, raw/calibrated probabilities, source span offsets, full retrieval scores, every intervention, calibration rows, epoch-selection rows, liveness gradients/deltas, all tensor checkpoint bytes/fingerprints, independent reconstruction and source pins.

mechanism_gates.completion: All registered source rows and original intent rows, all controls, ten epochs, strict selected restore, independent reconstruction. Any missing/failed arm/control or absent/nonfinite/reversed required interval fails closed; no independent NN replay claim from byte reconstruction.
mechanism_gates.QASPER_Bool_each: Top1>=0.80, model-minus-FIT-prior accuracy nominal lower bound>0 and prior-minus-model Brier improvement nominal lower bound>0. Model-minus-question-masked accuracy lower bound>0. Report every count, especially small147-row/38-calibration yes_no support.
mechanism_gates.retrieval: All-native-item Recall@10>=0.80 and model-minus-TF-IDF native-item Recall@10 lower bound>0; model-minus-question-masked Recall@10 lower bound>0. Unmatched native items cannot be excluded.
mechanism_gates.extraction: Observed-nonempty-native-annotation token-set F1>=0.80 and model-minus-whole-TF-IDF-block F1 lower bound>0; model-minus-question-masked F1 lower bound>0. Exact set match and all-native-item exact recall separately mandatory disclosures, not substituted for F1.
mechanism_gates.same_paper_question_swap: Every endpoint reports native teacher-changing/stable/unpaired counts and correct-new donor outcome. Zero changing/paired count earns no causal-transfer credit. Bool conditional correct-new>=0.80 when any changing pair exists; do not additionally require student to change to count correct-new.
mechanism_gates.original_intent_nonregression: Each original intent model-minus-original-cross nominal accuracy lower bound>=-0.01. Retain any regression as a negative, never silently route the endpoint to an old independent encoder.
mechanism_gates.structural: All source tokens represented, no question truncation, source-only payloads, stable semantic outputs under order, complete counted repeated-work path, peak allocated GPU memory<=12GiB. Counters are not performance measurements.
mechanism_gates.decision: Report per-endpoint PASS/FAIL/UNMEASURED and whole-study pass only if every mandatory quality/completion/structural/nonregression gate passes. All question endpoints remain source-native DEV evidence, not generic Boolean or transfer to arbitrary criteria.

resources.GPU: Serialized Modal T4 only, never local GPU; one model resident
resources.input_loading: Bounded streaming/deduplicated paper blocks; no all-core local model/tokenizer work. CPU source construction uses one thread.
resources.billing: User-authorized Modal; account credit/spend unobserved. Stop only on demonstrated account/resource error, preserve receipt, and continue reachable research.

failure: Preserve every failure and incomplete artifact. Implementation-only amendments must be prospective with unchanged sources/membership/targets/gates; no hidden retries or partial quality selection. Never modify transported sources while a registered run is active.
next_branch: If all question mechanism and original-intent nonregression gates pass, preregister fresh transfer/replication/OOD and many-axis study before promotion. If question endpoints fail, diagnose support and source-blind/variable-query controls, retain negatives and audit the selected cross interface before capacity escalation. If quality passes but original intent regresses, the shared adaptation fails; investigate joint-interference mechanisms under a new preregistration, never route around the regression.
source_rights: Retain existing QASPER licence/upstream/exposure boundaries; no new shipping grant, public raw corpus redistribution, free-form answer training or rater truth claim.

implementation_contract.data_interface: load_phase(phase, protocol_path=AMENDMENT) -> list[dict], phase only fit/selection/calibration/dev. Record keys id, endpoint, component_id, phase, serving, blocks, target. serving is the exact source-only original mapping; blocks are [{id,text}] from that paper/question's registered evidence catalogue, outside the model are coordinates only. target is separate registered native ledger, never a serving mutation. For native intent blocks=[] and target carries original native distribution; use existing guarded native data and convert losslessly. Verify all pinned historical/current authorities, phase membership and complete counts before returning any rows. Derive input_sha256 from canonical UTF8 JSON of serving, sort_keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False. No target/helper fields in that digest.
implementation_contract.trainer_CLI: neutral_qasper_cross_train.py --mode preflight|smoke|train --out PATH; canonical root default from amendment, --root may override only output location. CUDA is required for smoke/train and all actual model work; preflight is CPU input-only/tokenizer/custody, never model loading. Refuse existing output mode-directory, create immutable failure receipt on exception, no auto-resume. Parent supplies isolated Modal transport after implementation.
implementation_contract.outputs: Exclusive per-mode directory, metadata.json, liveness.json, history.json, selected.safetensors, selection.jsonl.gz (every epoch0..10 row), calibration.jsonl.gz, dev.jsonl.gz, baselines.jsonl.gz, question_masked.jsonl.gz, state_masked.jsonl.gz, question_swapped.jsonl.gz, reordered.jsonl.gz, candidate_count.jsonl.gz, repeated_state.jsonl, support.jsonl.gz, runtime.json. Use deterministic gzip mtime0, finite JSON only; no result overwrite.
implementation_contract.prediction_schema: Header kind=header, schema=vey.qnative.cross.capture.v1, phase, condition, protocol_sha256, source_pins, checkpoint_sha256. Every prediction kind=prediction has id, endpoint, component_id, phase, condition, input_sha256, status OK|UNSUPPORTED|ERROR, error null|string, candidate_ids, raw_logits, raw_probabilities, probabilities, temperature, ranking and spans. Bool coordinates false,true; native intent original full catalogue; retrieval full block catalogue with raw block scores and normalized calibrated masses; extraction candidate_ids/logits/probabilities empty, spans exact [{block_id,start,end,text,confidence}], where confidence is raw mean BIO token confidence, explicitly not calibrated string correctness. Any unsupported/error row is retained with explicit reason, never fake model logits/probabilities or invented gold.
implementation_contract.extraction_reconstruction: For every extraction prediction persist source-only window trace: block_id, window_index, original source token indices, exact token char offsets and raw three-way BIO logits for each source token. Independent verifier reconstructs greedy BIO and merged verbatim spans from these traces; never merely trust copied producer spans. Persist input IDs/mask SHA and full source coverage census. Question/special/padding logits are not decoded.
implementation_contract.support_and_interventions: Support rows bind all native item counts, matching IDs/occurrences, model token-boundary/window support and supervision masks to the original target ledgers. Control rows retain original source ID, condition, changed serving digest, donor_id where applicable, and per-control runtime counters. Preserve all not-paired swap IDs and reasons. Candidate-count rows bind component-seeded input-only prefixes and subset scores, never force teacher membership. Repeated-state rows bind both question IDs, weight/input cache identity, encoded sequence/window counts and cumulative forwards.
implementation_contract.verification_CLI: neutral_qasper_cross_verify.py --root PATH -> verification.json, independent target/metric/custody/control/checkpoint/selection/calibration/interval/gate reconstruction. Return nonzero on incomplete, malformed, failed or absent required evidence; per-endpoint semantic failure is a measured negative, not reconstruction failure. Receipt separates evidence_reconstruction status from mechanism_gates and whole-study capability. Do not import producer model/loss/metric/decoder helpers or execute neural forwards.
